transcript: Never drink water while you are eating. If you do, you've already felt the mistake. That heavy feeling, like your stomach suddenly becomes full, tight, slow. You think you're satisfied, but you're not. You just forced your body to slow down. When you eat and drink at the same time, you stop chewing properly. You rush the process, you disconnect from your food, and your body feels it. That's why, after some meals, you feel heavy, tired, almost sleepy. Not because of the food, but because of how you consumed it. A small sip is not the problem, but washing every bite down, turning your meal into something fast and unconscious. That's where the damage begins. Slow down. Chew your food. Let your body receive it the way it was designed to, because the man who cannot slow down with his food will never feel at peace in his body. Most people don't need more advice. They need silence inside themselves. If you feel that, the way back to stillness is waiting for you. Link in my profile.
